plainText:
Nemona (Japanese: ネモ Nemo) is a character introduced in . She is the player character's friend and hopes to find an equal rivalry with them. Nemona is the president of the academy's student council and one of Paldea's -ranked Trainers.

==In the core series games==
===Personality===
Nemona is an energetic and fun girl who adores battling with Pokémon. As an experienced Pokémon Trainer, she is among the strongest Paldean trainers, ranked as a , after moving to the region at the age of just seven. 

=====First battle=====
Winning this battle is not mandatory. The player will not black out and the story will progress either way.

During this battle, both the player's and Nemona's Pokémon are prevented from scoring critical hits.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

=====Second battle=====
Winning this battle is not mandatory. The player will not black out and the story will progress either way.

Nemona will stallize her at the first opportunity.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

=====Third battle=====
Winning this battle is not mandatory. The player will not black out and the story will progress either way.

Nemona will stallize her first partner Pokémon at the first opportunity.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

=====Fourth battle=====
Winning this battle is not mandatory. The player will not black out and the story will progress either way.

Nemona will stallize her first partner Pokémon at the first opportunity.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

=====Fifth battle=====
Winning this battle is not mandatory. The player will not black out and the story will progress either way.

Nemona will stallize her first partner Pokémon at the first opportunity.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
=====Sixth battle=====
The player's Pokémon will not gain any experience during this battle. Nemona will stallize her first partner Pokémon at the first opportunity.

=====Traded to the player=====
Upon the third unique interaction with Nemona in the League Club Room, she will trade a Paldean Tauros to the player in exchange for almost any Pokémon excluding , , or Mythical Pokémon.

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon Horizons: The Series===
 
Nemona is a supporting character in . Introduced as a Champion of the Paldea region, Nemona quickly befriended Liko, Roy, and Dot despite her competitive nature.

Throughout the series, she often helped mentor Roy and served as a friendly rival to him.

===Pokémon: Paldean Winds===
 
Nemona first appeared in Breathe Out. Nemona was first seen being watched by Aliquis as she taught some children the concept of stallization. Later, during Ohara's performance, she was seen attending the concert with Naranja Academy's academic staff. During the events of the episode, it was revealed that Nemona had a battle to wage against Aliquis.

In Breathe In, Nemona defeated Aliquis in battle, some time later, Nemona had a new battle against her rival, this time a Full Battle. Initially, Nemona was winning again, but the battle scenario changed when Aliquis made peace with his , upon seeing Aliquis's determination, Nemona decided to continue the battle with each of the Trainers Terastallizing their Pokémon. With new determination, the battle between Nemona and Aliquis continued.

In Take a Breath, it was revealed that Nemona managed to beat Aliquis in the last battle, thus achieving a score of three victories against her biggest rival in the Academy.

In Breathe Together, during the presentation of Naranja Academy's introduction video for new students, Nemona appeared presenting a talk to some students and then to the rest of the Academy's student body.

====Character====
Just like her game counterpart, Nemona is an avid battler. She also has a legion of fans at the Naranja Academy, which gained even more strength when she became a Champion.

====Pokémon====
 
 

==In the TCG==
===Nemona===
 
Nemona was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese and the English expansion, with artwork by Sanosuke Sakuma. This print features Nemona in her Naranja Academy uniform. Another version of the card with artwork by the same illustrator, featuring Nemona in her Uva Academy uniform, was released in the Japanese ex Starter Sets. 

 and versions of the card with artwork by Sanosuke Sakuma and aspara respectively was released in the Japanese subset and the English expansion. Nemona's Uva Academy card from the Japanese ex Starter Sets was also included in the Paldean Fates expansion.

The card lets the player draw three cards.

==Merchandise==
===Pokémon Trading Card Game===
====Nemona====
Nemona has had one series of unique merchandise released exclusively for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, simply known as Nemona, drawn by kirisAki. It was released on December 1st, 2023, tying in with the release of Shiny Treasure ex. 

 
====Paldea Pokémon Trainers====
Nemona and her Pawmo appear alongside other Trainers from Paldea on merchandise from the Paldea Pokémon Trainers line, released on July 11th, 2025 through the online Pokémon Center in the West. 

 

===Trainers Line===
 
Nemona and her Pawmo were included as part of the Paldea wave of characters added to the Trainers Line and released through the Pokémon Center in Japan on September 14th, 2023.

==Trivia==
Nemona's Student ID at the Academy is 805C001.
Nemona is the first rival to have completed her Pokémon journey prior to the events of the game.
Nemona's Gym Badges, seen in her dorm room, have a different design than the player's Gym Badges.
Nemona's Rotom Phone uses a Black Case.
Nemona, Clavell, and Iono are the only characters in the League Club Room that don't trade to the player a Pokémon or a pre-Evolution of a Pokemon that they are seen using in battle, that being , , and , respectively.
The Pokémon that Nemona and Clavell trade, however, are references to 's opening cutscene, where she is seen with a Paldean Tauros and he with a .
At time of release, Nemona was tied with Kieran for the highest-level Pokémon owned by a rival character, with her first partner Pokémon and his reaching level 87 during the Mochi Mayhem epilogue and the Blueberry Academy rematches. This record was broken in Pokémon Legends: Z-A's DLC expansion, wherein all of Taunie and Urbain's Pokémon reach Level 100 in their final battle and rematch teams.
Each of the three possible first partner Pokémon that Nemona adds to her team during the Blueberry Academy rematches shares a secondary type with the Paldea first partner Pokémon that has a type advantage over it: shares its type with , shares its type with , and shares its type with .
